exact_statement: For every nonconstant actual Boolean core g on any finite uniform physical cube, let g_d be the finite-depth oriented disjoint-copy iteration of the six-bit sign h negative exactly on {0,1,2,4,8,16,32,6,17,40}. At each level orient the minority negative; use that orientation if minority p<=7/32 and its complement otherwise; reorient the output to its minority. In entropy bits, for every finite d, -322/15<=H(g_d)/I(g_d)-H(g)/I(g)<=1088/15<73. The complete moderate prefix, including every partial prefix, has signed bill in [-50/3,172/3]; at most one ordinary segment and two complemented steps occur. Each ordinary segment is paid by reciprocal influence with multiplier Q>=19/16, signed node bounds -(19/3) Delta<=C/(Q I)<=(38/3) Delta, Delta=1/I-1/I_next. The rare tail has signed bill in [-24/5,76/5], using the independently proved C(p)<342p^2 and C(p)>=-Q*v*log2(e), v=4p(1-p). The exact terminal identity H_next=Q H+C and I_next=Q I retains the full starting core entropy. No absolute H/I or E bound and no physical restriction-tree payment is asserted.
